pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/103058

The test was generating wrong data (date strings without milliseconds, that did not match the date pattern)

comments:
```
failed to parse date field [+50856544-06-06T15:21:11Z] with format [yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z']
```

wrong test data, when the instant is ".000Z" (zero milliseconds) Instant.toString() strips the milliseconds and the date pattern doesn't match.

I see other tests failing in the same file: https://gradle-enterprise.elastic.co/s/s4fx4zhi7iz7g

Are these related?
Yes, they seem strictly related. https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/103075 should fix all of them

review_comments: super nit: probably doesn't affect much, but this could be a pre-compiled pattern to shave some ms off during test execution :D
